# vastdata_de_count_functions (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Count functions active within a time window.
# Both `start_time` and `end_time` are required and must be epoch microseconds
# (e.g., 1 hour = 3600000000 microseconds).
data "vastdata_de_count_functions" "example" {
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
  start_time  = 1700000000000000
  end_time    = 1700003600000000
}

output "function_count" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_count_functions.example.function_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_time` (Number) End time in epoch microseconds
- `start_time` (Number) Start time in epoch microseconds

### Optional

- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.

### Read-Only

- `function_count` (Number) The number of functions in the database that started between start_time and end_time.
